reasons: Cited text directly supports the compliant classification: Section 2.1 states no minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies and that declining further orders is not a breach or shortfall, matching the preferred position (fees for ordered services only).
Section 7.1 bars unlisted minimum-use charges and Section 12.3 confirms no minimum-volume commitment, reinforcing compliance; no volume caps on Customer usage appear.
No redline or comment proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding; original and rendered paragraphs are identical and deterministic checks are clean.
